name: Hungarian law: the Fundamental Law and the Acts of Parliament, every open time state of the Nemzeti Jogszabálytár from 2010
label: Hungary
history_note: NJT opens time states from 2010-01-01 (the Fundamental Law from 2012-01-01); earlier states are to be rebuilt from the Magyar Közlöny
author: the instrument NJT's footnotes name as making the changes new in that state; else 'Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (egységes szerkezet)'

citation.note: a section is cited inside its Act as "12. §", or book:section in the codes ("3:167. §", file 3-167-paragrafus.md); sections with a letter (8/A. §, file 8-a-paragrafus.md) are not matched
